// extraPaths: camera.py lives in colormixing/ and is imported as a bare 'from camera import ...' after run_health puts that dir on sys.path (_find_camera_dir). The legacy scripts import each other as bare siblings too.
// include: microdrop was missing here until 2026-08-20, so 2,747 lines of production code got no type checking at all -- and an editor opening one of its files analysed it outside the project scope, which is how built-ins came to be reported undefined.
